Typical process：First①/②Locating suspicious steps step_id，reuse③Get its complete output。without thinking(thinking)steps。Supports direct association with task history trace；The result is source_task_id/inherited=true and read-only。

name: record_fact
description:
explore【Fact/Conclusion】Write exploration graph，connected to the intention that produced it（intent_id）。Used to record exploration results——including fingerprints/enumeration etc.【positive conclusion】，and'port closed'/'Parameters cannot be injected'/'Login not found'Wait【negative conclusion】。
⚠️Multiple observations for one exploration【summed up into one fact】，Don’t split it into multiple pieces，If it can be combined into one fact, try to express it with one fact.：summary=A concluding sentence for this conclusion，detail=Relevant details（Can contain multiple specific items）。Example：Fingerprint intent→a fact {summary:'Recognized X The site’s technology stack and response characteristics', detail:'nginx 1.25 / Vue3 / 200 / title=.. / body_len=..'}，instead of status code、fingerprint、One title for each。An intention usually produces only one fact，If you break it down too much, the map will expand infinitely.。
★facts Arrays are used to write multiple items at a time【different from each other】conclusion（Each item can be omitted intent_id，Use top level by default intent_id）。Return ids array，with facts Equal length and same order。
⚠️Just write you in the tool output【Really see】conclusion，Don’t make up your mind。evidence with confidence Used to prevent inaccurate conclusions from contaminating the map：
  · evidence=support this conclusion【one line】key evidence（command+The one or two lines of output that best prove），**Be concise**——Details are in detail，Don’t stick to large sections of output here.。
  · confidence=observed（You can see it directly in the output）| inferred（inferred from phenomena）。
  · **negative conclusion**（Not injectable/port closed/Entrance not found etc.）write only"observe + tentative reading"——state what you actually saw，Whether the direction should be abandoned or not is determined by the planners based on the overall situation.；Be sure to give evidence，The means are endless or the evidence is weak（Only explore once、looks like）mark inferred，It has been exhausted and the talent mark can be seen directly observed。

confidence.description: observed（You can see it directly in the output）| inferred（inferred from phenomena）。Negative conclusions must be labeled truthfully。

detail.description: Relevant details of this fact：Write down various observations and facts from this exploration here.

evidence.description: 【one line】key evidence：command + The one or two lines of output that best prove the conclusion。Be concise，Don’t stick to large sections of output（Pay attention to details detail）。

evidence_version.description: get_finding_traffic Evidence returned version；Used to prevent reports from covering new evidence changes

report.description: Full text of detailed report,Markdown Format

name: update_mcp
description: Modify an existing MCP server(press id)。

id.description: To be modified MCP server id

insecure.description: http: skip TLS Certificate verification(Self-signed certificate settings true, Default false)

name: update_skill_file
description: write/cover a skill a file within(Default SKILL.md)。Used to modify skill content or add scripts/Quote。

name: AskUserQuestion
description: Asks the user one or more multiple-choice questions and returns their answers. Use it when you genuinely need the user to decide between options to proceed — not for things you can determine yourself or sensible defaults.

name: Bash
description: Executes a shell command in the working directory and returns combined stdout and stderr. Use for running tests, builds, package managers, and git. Prefer the dedicated file tools for file work. Set run_in_background to return immediately and read the output later.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return immediately; read its output later with TaskOutput or Read, and you are notified when it completes. A foreground command that exceeds its timeout is also moved to the background automatically.

name: Compress
description: Replace older conversation ranges with summaries you write. The originals are archived to disk first. Do NOT call this on your own initiative — wait until the context manager asks you to, and follow the rules it provides. A summary written without those rules permanently loses information.

content.description: One or more ranges to compress into separate summary blocks. Ranges must be disjoint.

endId.description: mNNNNN message ref, or bN block id, at the end of the range. Inclusive.

startId.description: mNNNNN message ref, or bN block id, at the start of the range.

summary.description: Self-contained summary that replaces the range in context.

topic.description: Short 3-5 word label for THIS range.

summaryMaxChars.description: Raise the per-summary limit above the 20000-char default. Use it when the content genuinely needs more detail — do not truncate critical information just to fit.

topic.description: Optional short title applied to ranges that don't carry their own.

name: Edit
description: Performs an exact string replacement in a file. old_string must match exactly once unless replace_all is set. Read the file first so old_string matches precisely.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit.

name: EnterPlanMode
description: Switches into plan mode: explore and design before making any changes. While in plan mode you may only use read-only tools. Draft a plan, then call ExitPlanMode to request approval.

name: ExecuteExtraTool
description: Invoke a deferred tool discovered via SearchExtraTools. tool_name is the deferred tool's exact name; params must match its schema.

params.description: Parameters for the tool, matching its schema.

tool_name.description: Exact name of the deferred tool (from SearchExtraTools / <available-deferred-tools>).

name: ExitPlanMode
description: Call when you have finished planning and are ready to implement. Presents your plan to the user for approval; on approval you may begin making changes.

name: Glob
description: Finds files whose path matches a glob pattern (supports ** for any depth, e.g. "**/*.go"). Returns paths sorted by modification time, newest first.

name: Grep
description:
A powerful search tool built on ripgrep

Usage:
- ALWAYS use Grep for search tasks. NEVER invoke `grep` or `rg` as a Bash command. The Grep tool has been optimized for correct permissions and access.
- Supports full regex syntax (e.g., "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+")
- Filter files with glob parameter (e.g., "*.js", "**/*.tsx") or type parameter (e.g., "js", "py", "rust")
- Output modes: "content" shows matching lines, "files_with_matches" shows only file paths (default), "count" shows match counts
- Use Agent tool for open-ended searches requiring multiple rounds
- Pattern syntax: Uses ripgrep (not grep) - literal braces need escaping (use `interface\{\}` to find `interface{}` in Go code)
- Prefer `head_limit` to avoid large result sets.
- Multiline matching: By default patterns match within single lines only. For cross-line patterns like `struct \{[\s\S]*?field`, use `multiline: true`
- Prefer Grep over terminal rg/grep for codebase search unless you specifically need shell features.

-A.description: Lines of context to show after each match (content mode).

-B.description: Lines of context to show before each match (content mode).

-C.description: Lines of context before and after each match (content mode).

-n.description: Show line numbers (content mode). Default true.

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, e.g. *.go or *.{ts,tsx}

head_limit.description: Limit output to the first N results (lines/files/counts). Default 250; pass 0 for unlimited.

multiline.description: Multiline mode: . matches newlines and patterns may span lines. Default false.

offset.description: Skip the first N results before applying head_limit (paging). Default 0.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the working directory.

pattern.description: RE2 regular expression to search for.

type.description: Only search a file type, e.g. go, py, js, ts, rust, java. Unknown types are treated as an extension (type:foo → *.foo).

name: LS
description: Lists the files and subdirectories of a directory (non-recursive). Use Glob to match by pattern across depth, or Grep to search contents.

name: Monitor
description: Starts a long-running streaming process in the background (e.g. tail -f, watch, a dev server, a polling loop) and returns immediately with a task id and output-file path. Use Read or TaskOutput to inspect it and TaskStop to end it.

description.description: Short description of what is being monitored.

name: MultiEdit
description: Applies several exact string replacements to a single file in one atomic operation. Edits are applied in order; if any old_string fails to match (or isn't unique without replace_all), the whole operation aborts and the file is left unchanged.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit.

name: Read
description: Reads a file from the local filesystem and returns its contents with line numbers. Use offset/limit for large files. Always read a file before editing it.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read.

name: RecallMemory
description: Searches your long-term memory for facts relevant to a query and returns their full content. Use it when prior context (user preferences, project state, past decisions) would help.

name: RecordMemory
description: Saves a durable fact to long-term memory so it persists across sessions. Record stable facts (user preferences, project constraints, decisions) — not transient conversation detail.

name: SearchExtraTools
description: Discover deferred tools (not in your tool list) and get their schemas, then invoke via ExecuteExtraTool. Query forms: "select:Name" exact, "select:A,B" multiple, or free keywords to match name/description.

name: Skill
description: Invokes a named skill — a reusable procedure — and returns its step-by-step instructions for you to follow. Use a skill when the task matches one of the available skills below.

args.description: Optional additional context for the skill.

name: TaskList
description: Lists the background tasks started in this session with their status, exit code, and command.

name: TaskOutput
description: Reads the output of a background task started by Bash (run_in_background) or Monitor. You can also Read the task's output-file path directly. Set block=true to wait for the task to finish first.

block.description: Wait until the task finishes before returning (default false).

max_bytes.description: Max bytes of output to return from the tail (default 30000).

name: TaskStop
description: Stops a running background task, killing its process tree. Pass a task_id, or omit it to stop all running tasks.

task_id.description: The id of the task to stop. Empty stops all running tasks.

name: TodoWrite
description: Records and updates a structured todo list for the current task. Use it to plan multi-step work and to mark progress — replace the whole list each call, marking exactly one item in_progress while working.

name: WebFetch
description: Fetches an HTTP(S) HTML page, documentation page, or API response and returns it as Markdown. Do not use this tool for static assets, including JavaScript, CSS, source maps, images, fonts, audio, or video—even if their URLs are found in a fetched page or explicitly requested. Fetch the owning page instead. Set `extract=true` to list comments, scripts, stylesheets, endpoints, forms, links, and meta tags. Listed asset URLs are for inspection only and must not be fetched. Large responses may be truncated. This makes an external network request.

extract.description: When true, append a RECON section preserving HTML comments, <script src>, inline-script endpoints, forms/inputs (including hidden), links and meta tags. Default false.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL to fetch. JS/CSS/static-asset suffix URLs are not allowed.

name: Write
description: Writes a file to the local filesystem, creating parent directories and overwriting any existing file. Prefer Edit for modifying existing files.

file_path.description: Path of the file to write.

name: shell_close
description: Close an interactive session(kill process、release PTY)。

name: shell_list
description: List all current interactive sessions and status。

name: shell_open
description: open a lasting PTY Interactive session running【interactive/Need to be true TTY program】(msfconsole/ssh interaction/mysql、python Wait REPL/Password prompt/nc session)，Return session_id。**Disposable、For non-interactive commands Bash**。mode: interactive=Block until first prompt/Silence and then return to startup output; hands-free(Default)=Return immediately, Use later shell_read polling; dispatch=Return immediately, Notify when completed; monitor=Return immediately, Behind the scenes watch Immediate notification of keyword hits(Session does not end, Only survives this run)。Can be set prompt_regex(Such as 'msf6? >\s*$')Accurate judgment completed。Be sure to use up shell_close。

command.description: interactive program to run，Such as 'msfconsole -q' / 'ssh user@host' / 'python3'

prompt_regex.description: Optional：Prompt regularity for command completion judgment(match end of output)

quiet_ms.description: Optional：How many milliseconds of silence is considered complete?(Default 8000)

startup_grace_ms.description: Optional：Start grace milliseconds，No silent judgment will be triggered during this period(Default 15000)

watch.description: monitor Pattern required：Keywords to watch for/Regular array，Notification will be sent when any one is hit in the output(Only report once for each)

name: shell_read
description: Read the output of an interactive session(Do not send input)。view=stream(Default)incremental raw stream(Streaming preferred,Continue reading/Yes drain Take the full amount); view=screen full screen vt Snapshot(suitable for vim/htop Wait for full screen program)。

drain.description: stream: true=Returns all original streams since the last(Ignore cap)

max_lines.description: stream: Maximum number of rows returned(Default 200)

since_cursor.description: stream: Read after this cursor; If not passed, the session internal cursor will be used to continue reading.

name: shell_send
description: Send input to an interactive session：text/submit/keys/hex/paste Can be combined，Send in order of appearance(See the fields for the meaning of each parameter.)。wait=true(Default)Wait for the command to complete and bring back the incremental output。

paste.description: Paste multiple lines(bracketed paste, Does not trigger line-by-line execution)

prompt_regex.description: Optional：Override the session’s default completion prompt

submit.description: Whether to append a carriage return after the text for execution

text.description: text to enter(No automatic carriage return)

wait.description: Whether to wait until the command is completed synchronously(Default true)

name: sleep
description: Waits for N seconds, then returns. Use to let a backgrounded command make progress before reading its partial output with TaskOutput. Interrupted immediately if the run is paused or stopped.

name: web_search
description: Search the web and return a ranked list of results (title, URL, description) — metadata only, up to 5 by default. Use WebFetch to read the full content of a specific URL. This makes an external network request.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20). Default 5.
